description: Get dividend history for one or more dividend-paying stocks (comma-separated symbols). A single symbol returns paginated dividend history plus analytics (CAGR, average payment, payout count); multiple symbols return a batch of dividend histories plus per-symbol errors (no analytics for batch).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

limit.description: Maximum dividend payments per page; omitted = curated default (25)

symbols.description: One or more comma-separated ticker symbols (e.g., "AAPL" or "AAPL,KO,JNJ")

name: get_dividends
title: Dividend History
